pages.text: The tower needs heat from blocks placed $(item)under the tank$(), across its whole footprint. A 2 x 2 tank has four heater spots, a 3 x 3 tank has nine. The heat of every spot is added up:

$(li)$(item)Blaze Burner$(), kindled: $(item)1$(). Superheated (seething): $(item)2$(). A smouldering blaze burner gives nothing.$(li)$(item)Firebox$(), while burning: $(item)2$() per block.$(br2)With a heat of 0 the tower does nothing.

Every tick, the tower runs the recipe once, multiplied by $(item)heat / 2$(). A heat of 2 runs the recipe exactly as JEI shows it, every tick. A heat of 8, the 2 x 2 firebox of the first page, runs it four times over.

The controller also needs at least the recipe input times that multiplier in its own tank before it starts a tick. Its tank holds 8000 mB, which is plenty for any heat you can fit under a tank.$(br2)Even a small heater processes oil much faster than a single pumpjack delivers it, so heat rarely limits a refinery. Use more heat when several pumpjacks feed the same tower.
